description: This file defines the data structures, classes, and functions related to the RLC (Radio Link Control) receive entity for Acknowledged Mode (AM) in a 3GPP 5G NR protocol stack. It includes SDU segment handling, receive window management, state variables, and interface methods for processing PDUs, managing timers, and reporting status.

classes.name: rlc_rx_am_entity
classes.description: Represents the Radio Link Control Acknowledged Mode (AM) receive entity responsible for handling incoming PDUs, reassembling SDUs, managing receive window, and reporting status.

classes.name: rlc_rx_am_state
classes.description: Holds the internal state variables for the AM RLC receive entity, including sequence numbers for flow control and reassembly.

classes.name: rlc_rx_am_sdu_segment
classes.description: Container for a segment of an SDU, including segmentation info, offset, and payload.

classes.name: rlc_rx_am_sdu_segment_cmp
classes.description: Comparator object for ordering SDU segments based on their offset.

classes.name: rlc_rx_am_sdu_info
classes.description: Buffering container for received SDUs or SDU segments, tracking completeness, gaps, and arrival time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all timers associated with the receive entity, preventing further timer events.

methods.name: set_status_handler
methods.description: Sets the handler for status reports to be sent to the transmitter.

methods.name: set_status_notifier
methods.description: Sets the notifier for status report triggers.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming PDU, dispatching it to control or data handlers.

methods.name: get_status_pdu
methods.description: Returns the current status PDU for reporting.

methods.name: get_status_pdu_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the current status PDU.

methods.name: status_report_required
methods.description: Indicates whether a status report needs to be sent.

methods.name: notify_status_report_changed
methods.description: Triggers an update of the status report due to new received data or changes.

methods.name: rx_mod_base
methods.description: Calculates the sequence number relative to the receive window base, considering sequence number wrap-around.

methods.name: inside_rx_window
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is within the current receive window.

methods.name: valid_ack_sn
methods.description: Checks if a sequence number is valid for acknowledgment purposes.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal state variables (for testing).

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current internal state variables (for testing).

methods.name: is_t_reassembly_running
methods.description: Checks if the reassembly timer is active (for testing).

methods.name: handle_control_pdu
methods.description: Handles a received control PDU, unpacking and forwarding it.

methods.name: handle_data_pdu
methods.description: Handles a received data PDU, including SDU and segment processing.

methods.name: handle_full_data_sdu
methods.description: Processes a full SDU contained in a PDU payload.

methods.name: handle_segment_data_sdu
methods.description: Processes an SDU segment contained in a PDU payload.

methods.name: store_segment
methods.description: Stores a received SDU segment, avoiding overlaps and duplicates.

methods.name: update_segment_inventory
methods.description: Checks if an SDU is fully received and whether segments are contiguous.

methods.name: reassemble_sdu
methods.description: Reassembles a complete SDU from buffered segments.

methods.name: refresh_status_report
methods.description: Rebuilds the cached status report based on current window state.

methods.name: store_status_report
methods.description: Swaps the current cached status report with a newly built one.

methods.name: on_expired_status_prohibit_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of the status prohibit timer.

methods.name: on_expired_reassembly_timer
methods.description: Handles expiration of the reassembly timer.

methods.name: log_state
methods.description: Logs the current internal state for debugging.
